notes.title: Doubling the amount of coins earned, forever!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192929/282753bf6a8010d197d292d5e7cb807b27549537.png"][/img][/p][p]Play [b]Grumpy Gaffer[/b] and [b]double your coin earnings![/b] The tougher the level, the bigger your reward.[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to compete in the Coliseum and stay tuned for new items for you to unlock with that! [/p][p][/p][p]- GG[/p]

notes.title: New Grumpy Content for you guys!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, we made some cool videos for you to learn more about what Grumpy Gaffer is about.[/p][p][/p][p]Mr Gaffer is getting really tired of their [b]#$%&!+* [/b][/p][p]Check out the essentials about Grumpy Gaffer[/p][previewyoutube="VnrBgFi9mk8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Nightmares are starting to get Mr Gaffer mad, learn how to end the suffering![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="HxHrjILsyHM;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Grumpy News and Updates!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45192929/e85c692951ee5cf465a0782dfd1f95365854a31c.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! We're very thankful for all your support. We hope you're enjoying Grumpy Gaffer a lot, and we have some news![/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Daily Rewards:[/b] When you enter the game, you'll get a random reward every day! Play a little daily to earn more power-ups if you need them to compete in the Coliseum or complete the campaign.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Sudoku:[/b] Now you can swap between "[b]Grumpy Style[/b]" and classic mode. Classic mode uses traditional numbers instead of grumpy faces, in case you prefer that.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smash Storm Tips:[/b] We've updated some tips in Smash Storm.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]News[/h2][p][/p][p]We're working on several updates for the game, thanks to all the amazing support from you guys![/p][list][*][p][b]More Unlockables for Grumpy Gaffer:[/b] We want to bring more unlockables, including profile avatars and skins or cosmetics for our characters. If you have any ideas, please let us know![/p][/*][*][p][b]In-Game Achievements:[/b] We're working on adding achievements within the game itself, not just Steam. This will include things like reaching first place milestones in the Coliseum.[/p][/*][*][p][b]YouTube Content:[/b] We're creating some YouTube content for you, including in-depth tactics and strategies to beat hard levels, and explanations of every game feature for you to enjoy! Stay tuned![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Once more, thank you all! GG[/p]

notes.title: Mr Grumpy likes cheap stuff
notes.content: We have made Grumpy Gaffer much much cheaper. Come grab a copy to support us. Thank you!
